statements.quote: Supported by very strong agentic AI-driven customer demand across its Integrated Memory and AI Infrastructure businesses, Penguin Solutions now expects full-year fiscal 2026 net sales growth of 22% plus or minus 2%, full-year GAAP EPS of $1.97 plus or minus 5 cents, and full-year non-GAAP EPS of $2.60 plus or minus 5 cents.
statements.notes: Total net sales outlook with AI-driven demand named as the driver. The 22% is growth in total net sales, not an AI share or amount, so it is recorded as qualitative with scope total. No AI or data-center revenue figure is stated.
